query:
-- Check Appcast slot 6 - currently has 1 booking (attendeeNumber 1), so Anna goes in as attendeeNumber 2
-- Also get Appcast sponsor rep info
SELECT m.timeSlot, m.attendeeNumber, m.attendeeId
FROM meetings m
JOIN sponsors s ON s.id = m.sponsorId
WHERE s.companyName = 'Appcast' AND m.timeSlot = 6 AND m.isVisible = 1;
